text:
Samir: Quick check — keystore cutover: staging smoke window tomorrow 02:00-03:00 UTC. Who's owning the gating smoke test, attestation evidence & auditlog backfill?

Lina: I can own evidence artifacts (attestation + proof-of-rotation). Need a pointer to the staging runbook.

Rob: @Samir i'll handle the gating smoke test and the rollout script. need access to staging HSM creds. @Maya can you confirm svc account?

Maya: Service account svc-keystore-staging exists, but not granted HSM connect role yet. @Oli can you grant or should I open IAM PR?

Oli: I'll add the role now. ETA ~30m. @Samir, can you add a quick checklist? I'll attach logs to the auditlog channel after the run.

Samir: Added checklist below. TL;DR: smoke write/read, keywrap/unwrapped, rotation simulation, auditlog entry generated. Please tick in comments.

```
- [ ] smoke write/read with test key
- [ ] keywrap/unwrapped check (verify wrapped bytes != plaintext)
- [ ] rotation simulation (create new version, rotate alias)
- [ ] rotation proof: signed attestation artifact
- [ ] auditlog entry present with correct request_id and HSM fingerprint
- [ ] abort criteria: any missing audit entry or failed wrap/unwrap
```

Lina: Quick Q — for attestation, do we need HSM connection fingerprint or just key IDs? Auditor asked for non-repudiable evidence.

Josh: From compliance side: we need both. HSM fingerprint + signed statement from the maintenance job. I'll draft the attestation text and link it here.

Rob: Also FYI: the bulk re-encrypt job will run Monday in staging. If smoke fails, we abort re-encrypt. Plan to gate the job with a feature flag.

Maya: :thumbsup: feature flag ready in branch feature/keystore-flag. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/keystore/pull/452 (staging-only).

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary staging-keystore at 2026-03-18T02:00:00Z by Rob.

Oli: Auditlog backfill: I'll spin up backfill with same job id and include start/end timestamps. Will tag runs with `keystore-staging-1777777888` and copy logs to s3.

Lina: After smoke, I'll upload artifacts to the compliance bucket: s3://redwood-compliance/soc2/keystore/staging/1777777888 and link the attestation doc.

Samir: Perfect. Action owners: Rob (smoke + rollout), Lina (evidence), Oli (IAM + auditlog backfill), Maya (svc acct + PR), Josh (compliance language). Ping me if blocked. :eyes: 

Rob: I'll post smoke run play-by-play in this thread during the window.

Samir: Last Q — do we need an oncall handoff for the window? @Nina (oncall)

Nina (oncall): I can take oncall for the window. If smoke fails, call page for infra will be triggered and I'll coordinate rollback. I'll be monitoring the channel and our alert dashboard.

Samir: Thanks all — will follow up with a short runbook link and escalation numbers before the window.
